Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

Summary: We are thrilled to invite an enthusiastic candidate to join the Central BD team, where you will play a pivotal role in planning and executing an exciting array of marketing campaigns and activations with our Listed Projects and Partners at Binance! This role is all about driving Central Marketing's strategic goals forward by harnessing the power of partnerships and supercharging our marketing initiatives.

Responsibilities:

• Partner Relationship Management & Budget Growth: Build strong relationships and engage with our Listed Projects and Partners of Binance to amplify the wallet share of marketing budgets!
• Marketing Campaign Planning & Execution: Dive into the planning, coordination, and execution of dynamic marketing campaigns that make an impact.
• Market Research & Partnership Opportunity Analysis: Conduct exciting market research and analysis to uncover potential partnership opportunities that can elevate our brand.
• Campaign Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Keep a close eye on campaign performance and metrics, and share your insights to drive success!
• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Campaign Delivery: Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to ensure every campaign is delivered with flair!
• Tool & Resource Management: Provide cutting-edge campaign and tracking tools to keep us ahead of the curve.
• Process Improvement: Enhance our operational workflows with innovative AI solutions to streamline partner processes and make everything smoother!

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or other relevant fields.
• Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills that shine!
• Ability to build and nurture deep relationships with a keen attention to detail.
• A passion for cryptocurrency, blockchain, and AI technology that drives your curiosity!
• Proven ability to work independently and achieve goals without the need for significant micromanagement.
• Comfortable juggling multiple priorities simultaneously in our fast-paced, global environment.

Why Binance

• Shape the future of finance
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
